name: AttachmentPreview
purpose: Inline preview of one attachment inside the lightbox, chosen by its type. A failure switches to the EmptyState card.
base: none (native img, video, audio, embed and pre)

values.when: img with alt set to the attachment name, fitted to the stage, rounded-control, object-contain, shadow-2xl, draggable false. About 480x300 (16:10).
Native video with controls and autoPlay, rounded-control, shadow-2xl.
Panel in the Card look (surface-2, rounded-panel, px-8 py-10) with a 40px glyph (weight 200) and native audio controls with autoPlay.
Embedded viewer (type application/pdf), rounded-control, h-full w-full max-w-4xl.
Selectable pre in surface-2, 12.5px, leading-5, max-w-3xl, overflow-auto, p-5. Capped at 262144 characters.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Default true for video and audio.

role: image: img; video and audio: native controls; pdf: embedded viewer; text: pre
keyboard: Native media controls for video and audio (play, pause, seek). Text is selectable. PDF uses the browser or webview viewer's keys. Image has no action.
platform: PDF depends on a built-in PDF viewer in the browser or the desktop webview; desktop WebView support must be checked (open). Web media is served from the server; desktop media is read from disk.
open: Merged: B's MediaPreview is this widget (B's text kind omission is corrected from A). B's error fallback names Card; A's EmptyState card is kept. The PDF embed has no onError in either design, so a failed PDF never reaches the fallback. Zoom and pan are not evidenced. Image radius not measured.
